<div id="readme" class="md" data-path="README.md"><article class="markdown-body entry-content container-lg" itemprop="text"><div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h1 class="heading-element" dir="auto">Tesserae.jl</h1><a id="user-content-tesseraejl" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Tesserae.jl" href="#tesseraejl"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto"><em>A Julia-powered toolkit for material point method</em></p>
<p dir="auto"><a href="https://github.com/KeitaNakamura/Tesserae.jl/actions/workflows/CI.yml"><img src="https://github.com/KeitaNakamura/Tesserae.jl/actions/workflows/CI.yml/badge.svg" alt="CI" style="max-width: 100%;"></a>
<a href="https://codecov.io/gh/KeitaNakamura/Tesserae.jl" rel="nofollow"><img src="https://camo.githubusercontent.com/cf3c1460a4e3e17db8d1ab4a3f06ae1d7bcebbb6a953e85d6bdfa646cd62310c/68747470733a2f2f636f6465636f762e696f2f67682f4b656974614e616b616d7572612f54657373657261652e6a6c2f67726170682f62616467652e7376673f746f6b656e3d48354248574949425447" alt="codecov" data-canonical-src="https://codecov.io/gh/KeitaNakamura/Tesserae.jl/graph/badge.svg?token=H5BHWIIBTG" style="max-width: 100%;"></a></p>
<p dir="auto">Tesserae is a toolkit for implementing the material point method in Julia. It is designed to maintain consistency between mathematical expressions and source code, enabling rapid development. Current features include:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Grid and particle generation</li>
<li>Various interpolation types, including B-splines, GIMP, CPDI, and MLS-MPM</li>
<li>Convenient macros for transferring data between grid and particles</li>
<li>Multithreading support</li>
<li>Exporting VTK files for visualization</li>
</ul>
